description: Source file implementing Windows-specific Skia graphics utilities, including bitmap creation, conversion, and device context manipulation.

methods.name: CreateBitmapHeaderWithColorDepth
methods.description: Initializes a BITMAPINFOHEADER with specified width, height, and color depth.

methods.name: CreateBitmapV5HeaderForARGB8888
methods.description: Fills a BITMAPV5HEADER for ARGB8888 format with specified dimensions and image size.

methods.name: SkPointToPOINT
methods.description: Converts an SkPoint to a Windows POINT structure.

methods.name: RECTToSkRect
methods.description: Converts a RECT to an SkRect.

methods.name: COLORREFToSkColor
methods.description: Converts a COLORREF to an SkColor.

methods.name: SkColorToCOLORREF
methods.description: Converts an SkColor to a COLORREF.

methods.name: InitializeDC
methods.description: Initializes a device context with default settings for drawing.

methods.name: LoadTransformToDC
methods.description: Loads an SkMatrix transformation into a device context.

methods.name: CopyHDC
methods.description: Copies a region from one device context to another, with optional alpha blending.

methods.name: PrepareAllocation
methods.description: Prepares and returns SkImageInfo for a given device context and bitmap.

methods.name: MapPlatformSurface
methods.description: Maps a device context to an SkSurface.

methods.name: MapPlatformBitmap
methods.description: Maps a device context to an SkBitmap.

methods.name: CreateBitmapHeaderForN32SkBitmap
methods.description: Creates a BITMAPINFOHEADER for an SkBitmap with 32-bit color.

methods.name: CreateHGlobalForByteArray
methods.description: Creates a global memory handle from a byte array.

methods.name: CreateDIBV5ImageDataFromN32SkBitmap
methods.description: Creates a DIBV5 image data handle from an SkBitmap.

methods.name: CreateHBitmapFromN32SkBitmap
methods.description: Creates an HBITMAP from an SkBitmap.

methods.name: CreateBitmapHeaderForXRGB888
methods.description: Creates a BITMAPINFOHEADER for XRGB888 format.

methods.name: CreateHBitmapXRGB8888
methods.description: Creates an HBITMAP with XRGB8888 format and optional shared section.
